label: Harris Shutter
blurb: The old Kodak trick of shooting one picture three times through a red, a green and a blue filter, a moment apart. Everything that holds still adds back up to its true colour, while anything that moves splits into separate red, green and blue copies with yellow, cyan and magenta where they overlap: water, flags, crowds and dancers turn to rainbows. The three moments are real earlier frames, so playback, stepping and export agree.

params.label: Time from first to last colour
